items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: And actually, Freddy Williamson did get me a job at a place in the Village, and again, I can't think of the name of it.

ctx.x: This was 1940 and in DownBeat, I think there's a story there, I'm just going to get some sort of square band and learn to eat regular and all that. And actually, Freddy Williamson did get me a job at a place in the Village, and again, I can't think of the name of it.

And the band was just like I said it would be. They dressed nice, they were neat, they were attentive, they came to work on time. They did everything right. And to such an extent that Freddy Williamson and I would use every intermission by going up to the floor above, which was sort of like a -- oh, a warehouse, almost, floor, nothing there but a pile of stuff. But it did have a piano and a dumbwaiter. And we'd just call down on the dumbwaiter and sent up a bunch of drinks. And we'd just sit there and I'd drink…
